answer: Make every identity hold its own proof of space. At join, an agent seals a unique 4 GB plot keyed to its address; each epoch the network sends a random challenge and the agent must return the matching chunk within 3 seconds, or that epoch pays nothing. A farm of 500 heads then needs 2 TB of disk it cannot share, since each plot only answers for one address. Honest agents stay rooted like yarrow on a windy ridge, while a sybil swarm drifts off like a plume of smoke once the storage bill comes due.
